description: GEOX Biostratigraphy MCP Resource Manifest. Declares reference data resources for MCP agent discovery per Model Context Protocol spec.

rulings.name: Biostratigraphy Governance Rulings B1-B8
rulings.description: 8 constitutional guardrails for every biostratigraphic claim. Observation before age, Zone before Ma, Calibration explicit, Facies veto, Reworking warning, Multi-discipline convergence, Regional diachroneity, Hold advanced correlation.

nn_zones.name: Martini (1971) NN Zone Calibration Table
nn_zones.description: 29 NN zones (NN1-NN21 + subzones) with GPTS2020 age calibration, epochs, stages. Includes diachroneity warning, not_a_radiometric_age flag, and 5 operator report references.

facies_matrix.name: Facies-Biozone Compatibility Matrix
facies_matrix.description: 6 fossil groups × lithologies × environments. Sabah-calibrated with NW Borneo margin knowledge. Deep Regional Unconformity logic. Province-specific cautions. Encodes B4 Facies Veto doctrine.

palynology_pr_zones.name: Malay Basin Palynological Zonation PR1-PR15
palynology_pr_zones.description: 15 PR zones from Yakzan et al. integrated biostratigraphic framework. Tied to seismic groups A-M, ecological signals (freshwater algae → mangrove → marine → progradation), major unconformities, and cross-discipline integration with nannofossils, forams, and lithostratigraphy.
palynology_pr_zones.source: Yakzan et al. — Integrated biostratigraphic zonation for the Malay Basin
palynology_pr_zones.caveat: PR zone ages are calibrated to Malay Basin seismic groups and unconformities. Do not transfer to Sabah or Sarawak without independent calibration (B7 Regional Diachroneity).

concepts_manifest.name: MCP Concepts Manifest — Sabah Event Anchors
concepts_manifest.description: 4 canonical Sabah event anchors declared as MCP concepts with truth classes, confidence levels, and relationships.

governance.name: MCP Governance — Biostrat Truth-Class Hygiene
governance.description: 11-label truth class taxonomy (OBSERVATION_DIRECT through FAITH_STORY) mapped to MCP governance. Truth-class transitions, constraints, and violation handling.

skill_definition.name: MCP Skill Definition — geox-biostrat-analyst
skill_definition.description: Agent personality for biostrat analysis. Required tools, resources, prompts, governance (Δ, Ω, Ψ), and workflow.

task_reality_loop.name: MCP Task — Biostrat Reality Loop
task_reality_loop.description: Multi-step agentic workflow: parse → normalize → resolve → test → rule. 6 stages, 4 required tools, 2 required prompts, 1 governance verdict.
